content.title: THE MINERAL YOUR THYROID IS BEGGING {{YOU}} FOR
facts: **Iodine (Thyroid Fuel)** — your thyroid literally cannot make hormones without it, and those hormones control your metabolism, energy, and body temperature.
**Seaweed** – nori, kombu, and wakame are some of the richest natural sources on earth.
**Cod** – 1 small fillet (about 85g) covers a big chunk of your daily need.
**Dairy** – 1 cup of milk or yogurt/day adds up more than people realize.
**Eggs** – the iodine sits mostly in the yolk, so don't skip it.
**Shrimp** – a handful (about 100g) is a solid low-calorie source.
**Iodized salt** – just 1/4 tsp/day can meaningfully cover your needs if you don't eat much seafood.
**Prunes** – 5 dried prunes/day sneak in iodine most people never expect from fruit.
**Follow along** – for more daily health tips like this.

caption:
Let's talk about iodine, because most people only think about it when a doctor mentions their thyroid. Seaweed is one of the most concentrated natural sources out there — even a small strip of nori can supply a surprising amount, since sea plants pull iodine directly from ocean water and store it. Cod and other white fish absorb iodine the same way, which is part of why coastal diets historically had fewer thyroid issues than inland ones. And prunes are the sleeper pick here — nobody expects a dried fruit to help thyroid function, but they quietly contribute meaningful amounts alongside fiber for digestion. Everyone's body is different, so pay attention to how you feel and talk to a doctor if something feels off.
